GazloweXplodiumChargeRocketBoots.name: Rocket Boots
GazloweXplodiumChargeRocketBoots.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

GazloweBigGameHunter.name: Big Game Hunter
GazloweBigGameHunter.description: Increase maximum Scrap by 2. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes, Mercenaries, or Monsters accelerates Reduce, Reuse, Recycle Scrap regeneration by 1.5 seconds.

GazloweOneManWreckingCrew.name: One Man Wrecking Crew
GazloweOneManWreckingCrew.description: Casting Basic Abilities cause Gazlowe's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal 75% more damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

GazloweRockItSockIt.name: Rock It Sock It
GazloweRockItSockIt.description: Casting Rock-It! Turret grants Gazlowe a Shield that absorbs up to 200 damage for 2.5 seconds.

GazloweHyperfocusCoils.name: Hyperfocus Coils
GazloweHyperfocusCoils.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

TinkerMasteryEZPZDimensionalRipper.name: EZ-PZ Dimensional Ripper
TinkerMasteryEZPZDimensionalRipper.description: Activate to gain 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%, and reduce damage dealt by all nearby enemy Heroes and Summons by 50% for 3 seconds

TinkerMasteryGoblinFusion.name: Goblin Fusion
TinkerMasteryGoblinFusion.description: Generate 3 Scrap for each Hero hit by Deth Lazor.

GazloweOverload.name: Overload
GazloweOverload.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

GazloweMasterBlaster.name: Master Blaster
GazloweMasterBlaster.description: Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge Slow enemies hit by 35% for 3 seconds. Rock-It! Turret Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed in this way extend the Slow duration by 0.5 seconds.

TinkerHeroicAbilityRoboGoblin.name: Robo-Goblin
TinkerHeroicAbilityRoboGoblin.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Passive: Basic Attacks deal 100 bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

TinkerHeroicAbilityGravOBomb3000.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
TinkerHeroicAbilityGravOBomb3000.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

GazloweRockItTurretPositiveReinforcement.name: Positive Reinforcement
GazloweRockItTurretPositiveReinforcement.description: Primary Rock-It! Turret attacks against Heroes increase Gazlowe's Attack Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

GazloweRockItTurretSuperiorSchematics.name: Superior Schematics
GazloweRockItTurretSuperiorSchematics.description: Rock-It! Turrets attack up to 2 additional enemies for 60% damage and have 30% increased Basic Attack range.

GazloweRockItTurretOverchargedCapacitors.name: Overcharged Capacitors
GazloweRockItTurretOverchargedCapacitors.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

GazloweDethLazorFirinMahLazorz.name: Firin' Mah Lazorz
GazloweDethLazorFirinMahLazorz.description: Firing Deth Lazor causes all of Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets to fire a Deth Lazor of their own that deals 125 damage.

GazloweXplodiumChargeArkReaktor.name: Ark Reaktor
GazloweXplodiumChargeArkReaktor.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds. These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

GazloweOverklock.name: Overklock
GazloweOverklock.description: Basic Attacks grant Gazlowe 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Dealing Basic Attack damage to Heroes causes them to take an additional 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

TinkerMasteryMechaLord.name: Mecha-Lord
TinkerMasteryMechaLord.description: Basic Attacks increase Gazlowe's Armor by 10 for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 30, and deal 50% bonus damage to Stunned or Slowed enemies.

TinkerMasteryMiniatureBlackHole.name: Miniature Black Hole
TinkerMasteryMiniatureBlackHole.description: Increase Grav-O-Bomb 3000's radius by 25% and its damage by 50%. Each enemy Hero pulled reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

TinkerItsRainingScrap.name: It's Raining Scrap
TinkerItsRainingScrap.description: Reduce the Scrap cost of Rock-It! Turrets by 1. Regain 2 Scrap for each Scrap pickup.

GazloweXplodiumChargeBombToss.name: Bomb Toss
GazloweXplodiumChargeBombToss.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.
